title: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
notes: Level achievements unlock when a level finishes loading (loading a save counts too).
Combat achievements use the game's own mission statistics, which count per mission.
Read from the game DLL, which Steam doesn't scramble.

testGuide.title: Start Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
testGuide.detail: Start a new game or load a save. "Current map" should show the level name.

testGuide.title: Fight
testGuide.detail: "Enemies killed" should count up as you defeat enemies.
